# Ray casts and You

Source: [1948](https://workshop.codes/wiki/articles/1948); edited 2023-06-20. Evidence: archived documentation.

Not independently verified in the current game. An article edit date is not a behavioral test date.

<a id="wiki-1948-n1"></a>

- Raycasts use start and end positions and terminate at end even in empty space; end should be start + direction*distance, not a direction alone.

<a id="wiki-1948-n2"></a>

- No-hit defaults differ: hit position returns end position; hit player returns Null; hit normal returns direction from end back to start.

<a id="wiki-1948-n3"></a>

- Surface normals are unit vectors perpendicular to the surface, useful for bouncing/wall jumps.

<a id="wiki-1948-n4"></a>

- Camera ray example starts at Eye Position, extends Facing Direction by 200, and excludes the casting player.
